# Bilolidin — Digital Product Developer

> Bilolidin is a full-stack developer based in Osh, Kyrgyzstan. He builds and
> grows digital products for business: websites, web services (client portals,
> internal tools) and automation — from the first version to an existing product.

## Services

- Websites: a site that explains the business clearly and brings in clients.
- Web services: client portals, online services and internal tools.
- Automation: requests, spreadsheets, notifications and reports run on their own.
- New products: a fast first version to test an idea with real people.
- Product growth: improving, extending and moving an existing product forward.

## Facts

- Location: Osh, Kyrgyzstan. Works locally and remotely worldwide.
- Languages: English, Russian, Uzbek, Kyrgyz, Spanish.
- Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase.
- Engagement: short call, then a proposal with fixed scope, timeline and price.
- Typical timeline: a landing page in one to two weeks, a web service from four weeks.
